message.content:
Run a comprehensive fleet status check on the Hermes agent fleet. Check:
1. Which agents are currently running and their recent activity
2. Any ALERT/FAIL/STALE status from heartbeat checks
3. Recent logs or artifacts that indicate fleet health issues
4. Memory staleness (check for agents with memory/ mtime >7 days behind artifact mtime)
5. Overall fleet operational status

Provide a summary of fleet health with any P0/P1 issues.
